reason: The frozen v4a experiment spec is a tracked text file stored with LF in Git but may be checked out with CRLF on Windows. Raw-byte SHA-256 therefore differs although semantic content is unchanged.
change: Verify the frozen v4a spec by exact raw SHA-256 first, then by a line-ending-only canonical-LF SHA-256 fallback. CSV and generated run-artifact hashes remain raw-byte exact.
